channel.description: Latest Microsoft 365 Message Center messages and Microsoft 365 Roadmap posts. Message Center posts vary by tenant; always use your tenant's Message Center as the source of truth.

item.title: MC1166852: Microsoft Viva Copilot Analytics launches new agent dashboard
item.description: Microsoft Viva Copilot Analytics introduces a new Agent Dashboard for tracking agent adoption trends and Copilot credit usage, rolling out publicly in February 2026. It offers detailed metrics, retention trends, and agent insights, accessible via Viva Insights, with controls for managing access and no identified compliance issues.

item.title: MC1486295: Microsoft OneDrive and SharePoint: Generate smart tables of contents for PDFs on the web with Copilot
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot users can generate AI-created, hierarchical, clickable tables of contents for PDFs in OneDrive and SharePoint on the web starting December 2026. The feature is user-initiated, respects permissions, supports saving by editors, and may have inaccuracies, especially with scanned PDFs.

item.title: MC1486292: Prompt Column backfill
item.description: Bulk generation of AI prompt column values for existing Dataverse records will be generally available November 16, 2026. This asynchronous background job consumes AI credits and requires enabling specific environment settings. Users can review and manage jobs in System Jobs, ensuring historical data gains AI-generated insights.

item.title: MC1486289: Microsoft Purview |Unified Classification Management Experience
item.description: Microsoft Purview is launching a unified Classification Management experience for admins to manage classifiers consistently. Public Preview starts early October 2026; General Availability by late November 2026. It integrates various classifier types and includes admin controls manageable via Entra ID group membership.

item.title: MC1486284: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Administrative Units support for DLP policies for Microsoft Copilot
item.description: Microsoft Purview extends Microsoft Entra Administrative Units support to Copilot DLP policies, enabling delegated management within units while maintaining existing RBAC. Rollout starts late October 2026. No action required; organizations using AUs should review structure and assignments. Tenant-wide policies remain unchanged.

item.title: RM573280: Outlook: Draft, edit and format emails conversationally with Copilot in Outlook
item.description: In Outlook, Copilot now works side by side with users to draft, refine, and format emails conversationally, powered by the same agentic capabilities available in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

item.title: RM573451: Microsoft Teams: Third-party synthetic audio and video (deepfake) detection in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Organizations can enhance meeting security with synthetic audio and video (deepfake) detection solutions provided by certified third-party providers. Third-party detection solutions analyze meeting media for signs of synthetic or manipulated audio and video and send detection signals to Teams, enabling integrated in-meeting experiences and controls. item.title: RM573452: Microsoft Teams: Onboarding workflow for new team members
item.description: Help people get started faster by automatically connecting new team members to relevant channels when they join a team. Improve engagement, accelerate onboarding, and make it easier to discover important information from day one.

item.title: RM571682: Power Apps: Modern, refreshed look for embedded model-driven apps
item.description: Extends the modern, refreshed look to embedded app experiences so model-driven app content retains consistent Fluent styling and interaction patterns when it appears inside another host. This was previously enabled for the monthly channel with the 2602.1 release and is now being enabled for the semiannual channel with the 2609.3 release.

item.title: RM571675: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Automate optimizations with Scheduling Operations Agent
item.description: This release expands the optimization capabilities of the Scheduling Operations Agent to include the ability to create recurring optimizations on a schedule. The agent considers the availability of the resources, their current schedules, and unscheduled requirements. It suggests a schedule that honors configured constraints and optimizes it according to the selected goal. The agent automatically runs optimizations and applies the results on the configured schedule.

item.title: RM571400: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Chat: Access to UBB models via the model selector
item.description: Users will be able to access models that require usage-based billing (UBB) from the model selector in Chat. Tenant admins will need to allocate credits so that users can interact with these models. If users consume their allotted credits, they will be able to request credits from their tenant admins.

item.title: RM571394: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use Dataverse Business Skills in Sales Agent
item.description: Business Skills are natural language instructions authored and stored in Microsoft Dataverse that teach Sales Agent how work gets done within a specific organization. Business Skills enable organizations to create natural language instructions for Sales Agent to follow, which represent their business processes, policies, and business knowledge. Business skills can represent common sales workflows such as lead qualification, pipeline reviews, account planning, opportunity scoring, account brief c...

item.title: RM561040: Microsoft Edge: Commercial Journeys - AI-powered task completion for Microsoft 365 Copilot users
item.description: Commercial Journeys helps information workers stay on top of their most important work when browsing in Microsoft Edge. Powered by AI, it proactively surfaces unfinished, new, and recurring tasks on the Copilot new tab page- with context-rich cards that explain why each task matters now. One click opens a guided execution flow that delivers ready-to-use outputs (emails, documents, presentations, and more), so users can complete their unfinished work faster with higher quality. This feature will...

item.title: RM573156: Microsoft Teams: Start side conversations during meetings
item.description: Keep collaboration moving without disrupting the main discussion. Start and continue one-to-one or small-group conversations directly from a meeting to ask questions, coordinate next steps, share information, and collaborate in parallel while staying engaged in the conversation, reducing context switching and helping teams stay focused and productive.

item.title: RM552598: Microsoft Edge: Improvements to site permissions user interfaces
item.description: To better align with user expectations, site permissions are changing to look and work both in context on a website that is requesting permissions and when navigating to permissions from Settings. On a website that is requesting permissions, there are changes to the Omnibox and the Page Info dialog and permissions will be easier to see and modify in Settings.

item.title: RM573157: Microsoft Teams: Impersonation Protection for Teams meetings
item.description: Impersonation Protection for Teams meetings helps users identify potentially deceptive participants and meeting organizers. When Teams detects a potential impersonation attempt, it surfaces warnings and risk indicators to help users recognize suspicious identities and make more informed decisions when joining or participating in a meeting.

item.title: MC1469551: Teams admin center device state rules and health alerts retire; use Teams Rooms Pro Management portal
item.description: Teams admin center's device state rules and health alerts will retire by late October 2026, moving device health monitoring to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal. Admins must reconfigure alerts and integrations in the new portal; end-user experience remains unchanged. Existing TAC configurations won't migrate.

item.title: MC1279093: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Enhancing how we handle promotional mail
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will tag promotional emails as “promotions” and can auto-move them to a Promotions folder, learning from user actions. Public preview starts mid-April 2026; general rollout completes by late 2026. Admins control settings; users can customize via message moves.

item.title: MC1485411: Microsoft Excel: Excel canvas
item.description: Excel canvas, a new Copilot feature in Microsoft Excel, creates dynamic reports with visualizations and insights that update automatically with data changes. Available worldwide by late October 2026, it supports natural language interaction for report customization. No action is required; notify users and update training materials as needed.

item.title: MC1485169: Dynamics 365 Contact Center - Use role-based enforcement for recording and transcription downloads
item.description: We are announcing the ability to use role-based enforcement for recording and transcription downloads in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on October 31, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature helps organizations better protect sensitive customer communications by separating permissions to view recordings and transcripts from permissions to download them. Admins can assign new Dataverse security roles to prevent selected users from downloading recordi...

item.title: MC1485120: Microsoft Outlook: Right-click to customize the classic ribbon
item.description: Microsoft Outlook now allows users to customize the classic ribbon by right-clicking on the Home or View tab to select commands and arrange them. This update began rolling out worldwide in late September 2026 and will complete by mid-November 2026, affecting Outlook on various platforms. No action is required.

item.title: RM566865: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Admin assignment time limit
item.description: Microsoft Purview is introducing the ability to set a limit in days when assigning users and security groups to role groups. This allows admins to define a fixed duration when providing admin permission on a temporary basis.

item.title: RM559613: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat can now better match search results from Scanned PDFs
item.description: Copilot Chat can now better match search results from Scanned PDFs on Copilot users' files they are working on — content that was previously difficult to search and find.

item.title: RM568369: Microsoft 365: [Education] Assign Different Content to Learning Groups in a Single Assignment
item.description: Enable educators to assign different content (attachments, resources, instructions) to different Individual Groups within a single Assignment. Today teachers must create separate assignments to differentiate — one for advanced readers, another for struggling students, etc. This feature collapses that into one assignment with group-specific content mapping.

item.title: RM568078: Microsoft Teams: Badges in Profile Card in Teams
item.description: You can now see Awards and Certifications as badges on a user’s profile card, bringing a more consistent experience across Teams and Outlook.

item.title: RM568762: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Agent Readiness in Microsoft Copilot Studio
item.description: Agent Readiness gives makers a real-time, always-visible health check for their Copilot Studio agents. A single "Review" indicator in the build experience surfaces anything blocking or at risk — from policy restrictions to missing evaluations — before it derails a publish. Blocked capabilities are grayed out up front with a clear reason, so makers never waste time configuring something that was never going to work.

item.title: RM569421: Microsoft Teams: Malicious URL Protection for Teams Chat and Channels for Gov clouds
item.description: Microsoft Teams can now detect and warn users on malicious URLs sent in Teams chat and channels in Gov clouds, increasing protection against malware attacks for Gov clouds customers.

item.title: RM571692: Microsoft Edge: Updated performance information in tab hover cards
item.description: Microsoft Edge is updating tab hover cards to provide clearer information about tab memory usage and memory savings when inactive tabs are discarded. Users will also have separate settings for tab-preview images and memory-usage information.

item.title: RM565216: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent call delegation
item.description: Incoming Teams calls don't wait for a break in your day. Intelligent call delegation provides AI-powered calling assistance so you can focus on the conversations that matter most. It answers calls and gathers context, helping you decide whether to pick up and engage the caller. It can also schedule follow-up appointments through an integration with Microsoft Bookings so you can reconnect with callers at a more convenient time.

item.title: RM569432: Microsoft Entra ID: Passkey support for B2B users
item.description: B2B users, including internal guest users and external users, will be able to register and sign in with passkeys issued by a resource tenant to meet that tenant's multifactor authentication (MFA) requirements. Today, passkeys are supported for member users in their home tenant. item.title: RM569721: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Ensure regulatory compliance by deleting inactive OneDrives and mailboxes for departing employees
item.description: Enables admins to delete both content and containers for departed users at scale thereby keeping your tenant compliant without any manual effort.

item.title: RM573244: Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations cross-app: Migrate finance and operations environments from Lifecycle Services to Power Platform admin center
item.description: The self-service environment migration feature moves management of an existing finance and operations apps environment from Microsoft Dynamics Lifecycle Services to the Microsoft Power Platform admin center.

item.description: With the new control in Viva Glint, service administrators can now configure whether to retain or delete survey and relevant indefinable user data for users who are manually deleted from Glint or deleted via the signals received via Microsoft Entra. item.title: RM566529: Microsoft Purview: View only Role management enhancements
item.description: Microsoft Purview is introducing a new view-only role management role to give admins permissions to see all the member assignments in Purview and Defender portal. This addition will be added to Global Reader and Security Reader in Purview and Entra.

item.title: RM515465: Microsoft Teams: Adaptive card-based app & copilot agent link unfurling in Teams
item.description: Discover and add SharePoint agents in chats and channels from in-context store. Users can click on 'Add agents and bots' from the roster drop down. This will open the in-context store, where users can discover SharePoint agents and add them directly to the conversation and collaborate in the group. Updated January 29, 2026: Due to a blocker we have paused rollout until March for this feature. We apologize for any inconvenience.

item.title: RM513275: Microsoft Viva: Engage Community feed improvements
item.description: Align the community feeds default experience with expected user behaviors; support triage and content review for users who want to read every message in a community.

item.title: RM493752: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Cloud Attachments preservation for users on hold
item.description: Enables cloud attachment preservation for users put on infinite hold so that file versions shared are preserved across any OneDrive or SharePoint site. This is a new capability which is different from the existing capability of applying label to cloud attachments and links present in OneDrive and SharePoint and shared in Exchange, Teams, Viva Engage and Copilot

item.title: RM492622: Microsoft 365: The Next Generation of File & Folder Sharing
item.description: We're now introducing the third generation of the Microsoft 365 sharing experience designed to make collaboration simpler, smarter, and more secure by default. At the heart of this update is the new hero link, a single, powerful link that controls access to your files. Whether you copy a link, share via email, or send the URL from your browser, you now have a seamless and consistent way to share and stay in control of your files.

item.title: MC1485116: Microsoft Exchange Online: Exchange Web Services (EWS) enforcement update for EWSAllowedAppIDs
item.description: Starting October 10, 2026, Exchange Online tenants must configure EWSAllowedAppIDs to allow Exchange Web Services (EWS) access; EWSEnabled=True alone will no longer suffice. Microsoft will auto-populate allow lists for some tenants, but organizations must review, maintain, and migrate from EWS to Microsoft Graph.

item.title: MC1187781: Viva Engage: Community feeds improvements
item.description: Viva Engage communities will default to viewing conversations by recent posts instead of recent activity starting October 2026. Users can still choose their preferred feed and sort order, with settings saved across communities. Unread indicators will appear in both new and all feeds. No action required.

item.title: MC1485056: Upgraded call history in Teams Calls app
item.description: Teams Calls app call history is upgraded to consolidate missed calls and voicemails into single entries and expand history from 100 to 3,000 records or 6 months. Rollout occurs worldwide in November 2026. No admin action is needed; users should be informed.

item.title: MC1485054: Microsoft Entra App Gallery: Self-service onboarding for new applications
item.description: Microsoft Entra App Gallery introduces self-service onboarding for new applications, allowing ISVs to validate SSO and provisioning integrations, manage submissions, and track status via the Microsoft Entra admin center. Public preview is available now; general availability begins mid-November 2026. No action required.

item.title: MC1243549: Retirement of SharePoint One-Time Passcode (SPO OTP) and transition to Microsoft Entra B2B
item.description: SharePoint One-Time Passcode (SPO OTP) authentication will retire starting mid-October 2026, transitioning external sharing and authentication to Microsoft Entra B2B. This change affects all Microsoft 365 tenants, requiring guest accounts for external users and enabling consistent governance and Conditional Access across SharePoint and OneDrive.

item.title: MC1454378: Microsoft 365: The Next Generation of File & Folder Sharing
item.description: Microsoft 365 introduces a third-generation sharing experience with a single "hero link" for files and folders, simplifying access control and updates. Rolling out worldwide in October 2026, it affects SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft 365 sharing. Admins can configure default link audiences per site, with no tenant-wide setting.

item.title: MC1479514: Microsoft Teams: Improved file sharing experience in external chats
item.description: Microsoft Teams will enable Attach file and drag-and-drop for external chats by default starting late October 2026, improving file sharing. Files are stored in the sender’s OneDrive with automatic permission assignment, subject to existing OneDrive/SharePoint policies. Admins can disable this via Teams PowerShell settings.

item.title: MC1261587: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management - Hard delete OneDrive and SharePoint files with priority cleanup workflow
item.description: Microsoft Purview introduces a priority cleanup workflow enabling admins to hard delete specific OneDrive and SharePoint content, even under retention or holds, with required eDiscovery approval. Rolling out from mid-2026, it reduces data exposure while maintaining compliance and requires explicit admin configuration.

item.title: MC796790: Unified management of app and agent availability and installation in Teams, Outlook, and the Microsoft 365 app
item.description: Microsoft is unifying app and agent availability and installation management across Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365 admin centers. Availability unification began in September 2025 in phases, with automatic unification planned. Installation unification starts late September 2026, synchronizing settings without admin action for eligible tenants.

item.title: MC1227622: Transitioning Teams Android Device Management from Teams admin Center to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal
item.description: Teams Android device management is transitioning from the Teams admin center to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal by July 2026, consolidating all Teams device management into one portal. TAC device management will be deprecated by November 2026. Admins should prepare by monitoring updates and updating documentation accordingly.

item.description: Microsoft Copilot is rolling out GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Sonnet 5.5 AI models starting September 30, 2026, across Cowork, Copilot Studio, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Chat. item.description: This feature introduces visual avatars in Business Central list pages to indicate which user or agent created or last modified a record. The capability enhances traceability and supports collaborative work by making identity information immediately visible without opening the record.

item.title: RM573381: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Service tools, skills and plugins are now available for Code
item.description: The updated Service application brings Dynamics 365 Customer Service context, actions, and guided workflows into Code. Customer service teams can work with service information and take supported actions in the flow of work, reducing the need to switch to Dynamics 365.

item.title: RM573366: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Review content generated by agents directly on pages
item.description: This improvement introduces the ability for Business Central users to review and approve content generated by agents directly on the pages where they work. You no longer need to navigate to separate task pane to understand that a given document was created by an agent. Instead, agent‑generated suggestions—such as descriptions, text proposals, or field‑specific updates—appear inline where they can be evaluated and modified before being applied.

item.title: RM573384: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Development - Page Scripting enters General Availability
item.description: The page scripting tool that can be used to record and replay user actions directly in the Business Central web client is moving out of preview to general availability. Thus the tool is fully localized and includes accessibility, usability, and visual improvements. We have also added new capabilitites to select multiple rows in grids and validate text displayed in message and error dialogs.

item.description: The updated Service application brings Dynamics 365 Customer Service context, actions, and guided workflows into Scout. Customer service teams can work with service information and take supported actions in the flow of work, reducing the need to switch to Dynamics 365.

item.description: This feature improves PO matching quality in Payables Agent and aligns draft finalization behavior with existing posting controls.

item.title: RM573378: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Sustainability Management - Track your carbon footprint with item journals and item reclassification journals
item.description: This feature introduces carbon footprint tracking to Item Journals and Item Reclassification Journals. It adds fields for CO₂e per unit and total CO₂e, and calculates emissions to ensure that emissions follow the same lifecycle logic as item costs.

item.title: RM573377: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Sustainability Management - Track your carbon footprint for fixed assets
item.description: This feature extends sustainability tracking to fixed assets by introducing fields and logic that capture emissions during acquisition, reclassification, and disposal. Emission data flows into the sustainability ledger and integrates with existing sustainability reporting. Validation ensures you can enter emissions only for acquisition transactions. Posting rules maintain data integrity across your fixed asset and sustainability ledgers.

item.title: RM573365: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Adapt faster with Power Platform - Map new Dataverse fields in Business Central
item.description: This feature simplifies how administrators keep Business Central and Dataverse aligned as Dataverse schemas evolve. Previously, exposing new or existing custom Dataverse fields required creating or updating a table extension (PTE) in the integration layer. Based on partner and customer feedback, this update removes that dependency.

item.title: RM573376: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Sustainability Management - Reverse Sustainability Ledger entries transaction
item.description: Keep your sustainability data accurate by reversing sustainability ledger entries that contain mistakes.

item.title: RM573374: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Sustainability Management - Use formulas to calculate emissions in purchase documents
item.description: This feature introduces formula-based emission calculations on purchase documents and uses the same calculation logic as sustainability journals. It applies emission factors to inputs such as fuel, electricity, distance, or custom amounts.

item.title: RM573373: Dynamics 365 Sales: Sales tools, skills and plugin are now available in Copilot Cowork
item.description: The updated Sales plugin brings expanded Dynamics 365 Sales context, actions, and guided workflows to Copilot Cowork, building on the native Sales skills already available in Cowork. Sellers can work with sales data and take supported actions directly in the flow of work, reducing the need to switch to Dynamics 365 Sales.

item.title: RM573368: Dynamics 365 Business Central: User experiences - Show recently used in lookups
item.description: Business Central now highlights recently used records directly in lookup dialogs. When users open a lookup, the system surfaces records they have recently accessed or worked with, making it easier to select the correct value without performing a search.

item.title: RM573367: Dynamics 365 Business Central: User experience - Preview images directly in web client
item.description: You can open image attachments in the Business Central web client without downloading the images first. Files display in preview mode with an easy to use viewer experience that's similar to the print preview or PDF preview features. If you want to save a copy, you can download the image file from the viewer.

Administrators can create and manage policies directly in Purview starting early October 2026, with global availability by late October.

item.title: MC1472591: Enhanced security and access controls for Outlook attachments
item.description: Outlook attachments now use a separate application configuration enforcing existing Conditional Access policies for download, preview, and upload. Non-compliant users are blocked from attachment actions. Admins should review policies, update help desk guidance, and notify users. Excluding attachments from policies requires creating a service principal for OwaDownloadAttachments.

item.title: MC1478975: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Use Microsoft Agent 365 agents as connected agents in declarative agents
item.description: Microsoft 365 now supports Microsoft Agent 365 agents using the Agent2Agent protocol as connected agents in declarative agents, expanding integration options. Administrators manage and approve these agents via the Microsoft 365 admin center. Rollout began late August 2026, enabling enhanced AI interactions and workflows.

item.title: MC1478958: Microsoft SharePoint Online: Select page canvas elements for Copilot-assisted editing
item.description: SharePoint Online now lets page authors with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license select specific page canvas elements for targeted Copilot editing, improving precision and user experience. This feature is generally available worldwide with no action required.

item.title: MC1446796: Migrate Free/Busy, MailTips, and Calendar Sharing before EWS deprecation
item.description: Exchange Web Services (EWS) deprecation starts October 1, 2026, affecting cross-tenant Free/Busy, MailTips, and Calendar Sharing. Migrate to Microsoft 365 Cross-Tenant Access Policy by September–October 2026 to avoid disruptions. Use provided PowerShell commands to check tenant impact and follow migration guidance.

item.title: MC1465768: Microsoft Teams: Users can temporarily pause all notifications
item.description: Microsoft Teams will let users temporarily pause notifications for a chosen time to reduce interruptions and improve focus. This feature, available on desktop, web, and mobile, rolls out worldwide from mid-September to late October 2026. No admin action is needed.

item.title: MC1477184: Microsoft 365 admin center: Agent Registry consolidates duplicate agent entries and adds version history
item.description: Microsoft 365 admin center's Agent Registry now consolidates duplicate agent entries into single records with version history, simplifying management and governance. Rollout occurs mid-September to mid-October 2026. Admins should update reports and documentation due to changes in agent counts; no action is required.

item.title: MC1482225: How to get the Windows 11 2026 Update
item.description: What and why: Windows 11, version 26H2, also referred to as the Windows 11 2026 Update, is now generally available. This annual feature update for Windows 11 includes features and enhancements delivered to version 25H2 over the past year in the areas of security, management, accessibility, and user experience. Rollout schedule: Windows 11, version 26H2 is available now for eligible devices running Windows 11, versions 25H2 and 24H2. For commercial and education customers, it is available through...

item.title: MC1387681: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: Policy recommendation panel in IRM
item.description: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management will introduce a policy recommendation panel by early 2027 to help administrators identify and address gaps in insider risk policies using analytics. The feature is enabled by default, improves risk coverage visibility, and requires no user workflow changes or action.

item.title: MC1470887: Microsoft Teams: Personal message reminders for chat and channels
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce personal message reminders for chat and channel messages starting early November 2026, enabling users to set, manage, and receive notifications for reminders. The feature is private, enabled by default, requires no admin setup, and will roll out globally by December 2026.

item.title: MC1458472: Simplified Copilot experience in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Microsoft Teams' Copilot experience will be updated in October 2026 with a simplified, chat-centered design featuring improved navigation, chat layout, agent interaction, and Work IQ controls. The full-screen view adds a Tasks view. No user or admin action is needed; admins should inform users and update documentation.

item.title: MC1458470: Simplified Copilot experience in Microsoft Outlook
item.description: Microsoft Outlook's Copilot experience will be updated in October 2026 to a simplified, chat-centered design with improved navigation, chat layout, and Work IQ controls. The full-page and side pane experiences will refresh, with no action or licensing changes required. Administrators should update user communications and documentation accordingly.

item.title: MC1288531: Microsoft Viva - Copilot Analytics: Export agent data from the Agent Dashboard
item.description: Microsoft Viva will add a feature allowing eligible users with at least 50 Copilot licenses to export de-identified Copilot agent usage data from the Agent Dashboard for analysis. Rollout begins late May 2026 (public preview) and late October 2026 (general availability). Admins can manage or disable this feature.

item.title: MC1454397: Updates to Tenant External Recipient Rate Limit (TERRL) Quotas for New, Trial, and Education Tenants
item.description: Starting mid-September to November 2026, Exchange Online updates Tenant External Recipient Rate Limit (TERRL) quotas for new, trial, and education tenants, adjusting limits based on tenant age and license type. Trial quotas reduce to 500 recipients daily; EDU licenses get a new quota formula. No immediate action required.

item.title: MC1481325: Microsoft SharePoint: Retirement of SharePoint Page Agent (Frontier)
item.description: Microsoft will retire the SharePoint Page Agent (Frontier) for SharePoint Online starting mid-October 2026, completing by mid-November 2026. Users must switch to creating and refining pages directly with Copilot in SharePoint. Existing content remains accessible with no migration needed. Organizations should update training and workflows accordingly.

item.title: MC1481318: Microsoft Defender XDR: Detection source support in alert tuning rules
item.description: Microsoft Defender XDR will allow alert tuning rules to target specific detection sources for finer control. This feature rolls out in public preview mid-October 2026 and general availability mid-November 2026. Existing rules apply to all sources unless updated. No action is needed unless customization is desired.

item.title: MC1481317: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: Retirement of Data Risk Graph
item.description: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management is retiring the Data Risk Graph by December 8, 2026. Users must transition to Activity explorer, Content explorer, and User activity experiences for investigations. Existing policies and workflows remain unaffected; no user action is required for the feature removal.

item.title: MC1481316: Microsoft Teams: Enable Teams apps and agents for existing applications in your organization
item.description: Microsoft Teams will enable admins to discover and recommend Teams apps and agents linked to third-party applications already used in their organization, improving integration and reducing app switching. This feature, rolling out in November 2026, requires admin activation and uses sign-in signals to generate recommendations without automatic changes.

item.title: MC1481315: Microsoft Purview: Retirement of Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) classic and DSPM for AI classic experiences
item.description: Microsoft will retire the Microsoft Purview DSPM classic and DSPM for AI classic experiences by December 31, 2026, unifying capabilities into a single current DSPM experience. Organizations using the classic versions must transition workflows to the new experience before retirement.

item.title: MC1481313: Microsoft Purview | DLM: Legacy Teams retention policies that cover Copilot will be treated as Teams-only
item.description: Legacy Microsoft Teams retention policies will no longer apply to Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions starting late October 2026. Organizations must configure separate retention policies for Copilot data to maintain compliance, as Teams policies will only govern Teams content going forward. Action is required if Copilot retention is needed.

item.title: MC1481309: Microsoft Entra ID: Enhance protection of the authentication experience by blocking external script injection
item.description: Microsoft Entra ID will enhance sign-in security by enforcing a Content Security Policy blocking external script injection starting mid-October 2026. Only trusted Microsoft scripts will run, affecting organizations using script-injecting tools on login.microsoftonline.com. No action needed if such tools aren't used.

item.title: MC1456609: Microsoft Purview | Information Protection: Auto-labeling per-policy coverage report
item.description: Microsoft Purview introduces a new auto-labeling policy coverage report to help administrators track labeling progress, identify issues, and assess policy effectiveness. Available after simulations, the report shows labeled, pending, and failed files for 30 days. Rollout begins early October 2026 worldwide. No action required.

item.title: RM570857: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Track costs for non-billable field work
item.description: Organizations often use the same field teams for both customer work and internal operational work, such as maintenance, inspections, or asset-related activities that are not billed to an external customer. These scenarios still require scheduling, technician execution, and accurate tracking of the labor, materials, and other costs associated with the work.

item.title: RM570665: Outlook: Send availability in Outlook mobile apps
item.description: We are bringing back send availability on both iOS and Android. iOS users will now also be able to access more of this feature via keyboard and voiceover.

item.title: RM386901: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Information Protection - Sensitivity label grouping modernization
item.description: To help improve label usability and configuration, the sensitivity labeling scheme will be simplified to only consist of labels and label groupings. These new label groupings allow admins to better organize and categorize their labels (previously done via parent labels).

item.title: RM571309: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Auto-labeling scale increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
item.description: We are increasing the maximum auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive from 100,000 up to 500,000 files per tenant per day. This helps organizations label and protect more of their data at rest, faster, closing labeling gaps across existing content. With sensitivity labels and protection settings applied to more files sooner, organizations can better prepare their data estate for Microsoft 365 Copilot with greater confidence.

item.title: RM571884: Word: Legal plugins in Copilot
item.description: Legal plugins in Copilot provide purpose-built skills to help legal professionals summarize, draft, review, and redline legal documents. Available in Word and Cowork, these plugins can use work context from Microsoft 365 and connect to supported third-party legal sources.

item.title: RM499076: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal: Information Protection- Scan existing files in SharePoint and OneDrive for business for sensitive information
item.description: This new capability will enable admins to scan existing files at rest in SharePoint or OneDrive for business for sensitive data.

item.title: RM565425: Microsoft Teams: Language selection by users in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Users can now choose their preferred meeting language in Teams Rooms on Android. Select from up to 69 languages using the language button on the console. The room system must restart after a language is selected.

item.title: RM567000: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Engage prospects faster with Sales Agent-enriched leads
item.description: To reach their sales goals, sales teams need to constantly generate enough pipeline. They need to decide which inbound leads to engage. This decision takes a lot of time because sellers must sift through large amounts of data across tools and data sources. This data includes information from internal systems like their CRM and external resources like the web and third-party data services.

item.title: RM567002: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Add custom insights to record summaries in Sales agent
item.description: Sales agent gives you strong CRM-based account and opportunity summaries, but important context is often spread across non-CRM systems. With this capability, you can add insights from any application to enrich account and opportunity summaries in Sales agent, so sellers get a unified view of their accounts and deals in one place without switching applications. UPDATE: This roadmap item is no longer accurate and will be removed from the roadmap. We apologize for any inconvenience.

item.title: RM567003: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Enrich Sales agent meeting prep with more data sources
item.description: Walking into a customer meeting with incomplete context can mean missed risks, overlooked issues, and conversations that fall flat. With access to richer data, like service tickets, directly in your meeting prep, you can spot open issues and opportunities before the conversation starts. item.title: RM498923: Viva Glint - Action Taking Report (Public Preview)
item.description: Introduction of a new report that provides transparency into platform activity by dashboard users. Metrics such as report views, Team Conversations completed, and Focus Areas created will be visible and filterable with this report.

item.title: RM567895: OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Android)
item.description: Multimodal capture enables users to transcribe audio, take images, and type notes in a single session. Copilot then creates a structured Copilot Page with insights and user-captured content, saved to a user-selected Copilot Notebook. Designed for capturing offline work moments—including in-person conversations, whiteboard sessions, and personal notes. This capability is already generally available on OneNote for iPhone and iPad.

item.title: RM568791: Planner: Refreshed experience and new capabilities
item.description: Microsoft Planner will be updated with a cleaner, more modern interface, improved navigation, responsive layouts, and a more consistent experience across Planner in Teams and Planner for the web. This update also introduces Goals in basic plans.

item.title: RM568792: Planner: Refreshed experience and new capabilities
item.description: Microsoft Planner will be updated with a cleaner, more modern interface, improved navigation, responsive layouts, and a more consistent experience across Planner in Teams and Planner for the web. This update also introduces Goals in basic plans.

item.title: RM569363: Microsoft Purview: Permissions audit log improvements
item.description: Improving permission checks when users access the Microsoft Purview portal. Enhanced audit logs will provide clearer visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions, helping administrators troubleshoot access issues and monitor authorization outcomes.

item.title: RM569608: Microsoft Teams: Enable agents for existing applications in your organization
item.description: For third-party applications already being used in your organization, admins can now discover and enable the corresponding Teams agents from within the Teams Admin Center. Admins receive recommendations for high-value agents and gain visibility into any required configuration changes during the enablement workflow. These agents increase employee productivity by bringing their everyday applications into the flow of work in Teams. This helps organizations get more value from their existing softwar...

item.title: RM570963: Microsoft Clipchamp: Copilot video creation updates
item.description: Copilot brings agentic video creation to Clipchamp Video Hub. Users can generate, edit, and refine videos from prompts—grounded in explicit documents or implicit WorkIQ knowledge. Preview and playback video directly in chat, then continue iterating towards a finished video.

item.title: RM570962: Microsoft Teams: Multi-line call history tabs in the Calls app
item.description: Multi-line users get a redesigned call history experience that organizes activity by phone line. Call activity is organized into dedicated tabs for each line, so history, voicemails, and recordings appear under the line they belong to, making navigation and call management simpler and more intuitive.

item.title: RM570469: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft M365): Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word and PowerPoint files
item.description: Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word and PowerPoint files is user's working files — such as scanned contracts in Word, text from tables, text from images — content that was previously difficult to search and find.

item.title: RM571879: Microsoft Teams: Granular Conditional Access for Teams meetings
item.description: Granular Conditional Access for Teams meetings gives organizations greater control over access to sensitive meetings. Administrators can apply Conditional Access policies to selected meetings, helping ensure participants meet organizational security requirements before joining.

item.title: RM567007: Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
item.description: We've introduced a new experience for Copilot in the apps—a consistent entry point across apps that sits above your work and understands the context beneath it. Rather than scattering touchpoints across the interface, it anchors Copilot as one connected system across Microsoft 365, surfacing relevant actions that help you stay in flow. With this release, we are rolling out this new experience - already available across other Outlook endpoints, as well as in Word, Excel and PowerPoint - to classi...

item.title: RM409534: Microsoft Teams: Local PTZ for Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will provide native Pan-Tilt-Zoom (PTZ) controls for connected cameras that support this capability, whether the camera moves a physical lens or adjusts the image digitally. Controls are available when Teams Rooms can confirm the camera isn't independently framing the room.

item.title: RM571308: OneDrive: Prompt gallery for Copilot
item.description: Discover easier ways to use Copilot in OneDrive

item.title: MC1441784: Microsoft Copilot for Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
item.description: Microsoft is updating the Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook to a new location next to the ribbon, enhancing visibility and providing AI-powered contextual recommendations. The rollout begins mid-October 2026 worldwide, with no changes to licensing or admin settings. No action is required, but user communication is recommended.

item.title: MC1459138: Microsoft Teams: Local Pan-tilt-zoom (PTZ) controls for Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will add native local Pan-Tilt-Zoom (PTZ) camera controls on the in-room console for compatible cameras, enabling manual adjustments during meetings without extra remotes. Rollout begins September 2026, with automatic enablement on eligible devices and no action required from users.

item.title: MC1479512: Microsoft Teams: Updates to Teams Events licensing for business, frontline, and education customers
item.description: Microsoft Teams Events licensing is updated to categorize features into foundational (available with eligible Teams licenses) and advanced (requiring Teams Enterprise licenses). Teams Premium no longer includes Events capabilities. Event attendee limits vary by license, with capacity packs needed for over 3,000 attendees. Admins must review organizer licenses accordingly.

item.title: MC1472592: Microsoft Purview: Auto-expanding archive capacity increases to 3 TB for eligible mailboxes
item.description: Microsoft Purview increases auto-expanding archive capacity for eligible Exchange Online mailboxes from 1.5 TB to 3 TB starting mid-October 2026. No extra configuration or charges apply. Administrators should verify license eligibility, monitor growth, and update documentation accordingly. Compliance impact is minimal.

item.title: MC1480873: Connected Platforms - Agent 365 extends observability to third-party agents
item.description: Microsoft Agent 365 now integrates observability for third-party agents from Amazon Bedrock Classic, AgentCore, Google Vertex AI, and Anthropic Claude Managed Agents into a unified experience. Administrators can monitor runs, sessions, tool calls, and exceptions across platforms. Rollout begins September 2026, with no action needed for existing connections unless observability is desired.

item.title: MC1480870: New SharePoint Mobile Experience on iOS and Android
item.description: The SharePoint mobile app for iOS and Android is redesigned around a personalized Discover experience, launching mid-October 2026 worldwide. It features improved site browsing, file previews, refreshed news, search, dark mode, and better performance, with no admin action or compliance concerns required.

item.title: MC1480869: Microsoft 365 settings enabled by default for newly created Engage communities
item.description: Newly created Microsoft Viva Engage communities will have Microsoft 365 group settings enabled by default, subscribing members to community emails and calendar invites. Community owners can adjust these settings in the My Account portal. Rollout completes by mid-October 2026; no admin action is required.

item.title: RM568781: Microsoft Teams: Proximity join support for attendees in Teams events from Teams Rooms on Windows and Android
item.description: Attendees can take advantage of proximity join with Teams Rooms on Windows and/or Android for fast, effortless connection to nearby room systems during Teams events, such as town halls, webinars, and structured meetings.

item.title: RM564969: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced IntelliFrame with AI data channel for intelligent cameras
item.description: Teams Rooms on Windows users can now benefit from next generation IntelliFrame features on certified AI-capable cameras with on-device video processing. With IntelliFrame’s expanded AI data channel, participants experience faster active speaker framing, people recognition and labels, and more responsive meeting views—even when network conditions are limited. These capabilities are available with Teams Rooms Pro.

item.title: RM554934: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in Outlook expands to reason over inbox, calendar, and enterprise data
item.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook expanding to support reasoning over a user's entire inbox, calendar and other enterprise data for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat users (without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license) .

item.title: RM516577: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Planner capabilities in Copilot chat (M365 Copilot)
item.description: We will support creating Planner tasks and plans querying Planner information in M365 Copilot chat, allowing users to manage their tasks and plans between Copilot and Planner seamlessly.

item.title: RM501451: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot in SharePoint
item.description: Simplifies SharePoint content management and ensures content is Copilot-ready by automating metadata, fixing stale content, enabling fast page creation, improving compliance, and enriching content so Copilot can deliver more accurate, grounded answers. Updated April 16: We are still in development for GA and have launched to Preview only.

item.title: RM499423: Microsoft Edge: Ground Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in Edge for Business in your open OneDrive and SharePoint documents
item.description: Get relevant answers and insights about your open cloud documents in Copilot Chat in Edge.

item.title: RM570862: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Support multiple payers across Work Order lines
item.description: Field work does not always have a single payer. A customer may be responsible for the primary service while another party, such as a warranty provider, manufacturer, partner, or other eligible billing customer, is responsible for specific products or services performed during the same visit.

item.title: RM570436: PowerPoint: Async Notifications for Copilot in PowerPoint
item.description: Enable users to leave PowerPoint, switch devices, go offline, or end their workday while remaining confident that Copilot will notify them when work is complete or requires attention.

item.title: RM570967: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration: Maker Guidelines
item.description: The Maker guidelines feature gives organizations a direct way to share guidance with Copilot Studio makers in the flow of work. Administrators can explain which tools, models, connectors, and channels are approved for an environment and point makers to the right policy, request process, or support contact.
item.category: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration

item.title: RM502520: Microsoft Teams: New sharing panel in meetings - improved content discovery and ease of sharing
item.description: The sharing panel in today’s meetings is the default place for content discoverability and sharing. New sharing panel UI is crafted with intent of modernising and simplifying default tasks such as window sharing, but also for easier discovery of sharing options and more discoverable file sharing.

item.title: RM570858: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Support multiple warehouse assignments for field technicians
item.description: Field technicians often source parts from more than one warehouse. Limiting a technician to a single warehouse can make it harder to reflect how materials are actually sourced across field operations.

item.title: RM571672: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Expand your service offering through subcontractors without the onboarding overhead
item.description: Business value

item.title: MC1479517: SharePoint: HTML pages
item.description: SharePoint will support creating, uploading, editing, and publishing HTML pages, including Copilot-assisted page creation. Rollout starts October 2026 (preview) and completes December 2026 (general availability). Pages are stored in the Site Pages library with existing permissions. No admin action is required before rollout.

item.title: MC1479516: Microsoft Outlook: Link preview retirement
item.description: The link preview feature in new Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the web has been retired worldwide. Links will remain clickable but no longer show preview cards. No action is needed, but users should be informed about this change.

item.title: MC1479513: Outlook: Insert Symbols
item.description: Outlook will allow users to insert symbols into emails via the Insert tab, rolling out worldwide from October to December 2026. No admin action is needed, but users should be informed, and training materials updated. This affects new Outlook for Windows, Outlook on the web, and Exchange Online.

item.title: MC1479509: Spell check before sending emails in new Outlook
item.description: New Outlook will offer automatic spell check before sending emails, rolling out worldwide from mid-October to mid-December 2026. Users can enable this feature to reduce spelling errors without manual checks. No admin action is needed; update user guidance accordingly. No compliance issues identified.

item.title: MC1479508: Microsoft Planner: Meeting-created plans will expire after 180 days of inactivity
item.description: Meeting-created Microsoft Planner plans from Teams expire and delete after 180 days of no task activity, starting October 2026. Organizers get advance email notices and can extend plans by selecting "Keep plan." Tasks in Loop and meeting notes remain unaffected. Deleted plans recoverable within 30 days via admin request.

item.title: MC1479506: Video recap in Microsoft Teams supports more languages
item.description: Microsoft Teams Video recap, which uses AI to create narrated highlight videos from meetings, now supports 23 languages and 31 locale variants. Available to Microsoft 365 Copilot license users, it requires meetings to be 10–90 minutes, recorded, and transcribed. Rollout begins late September 2026.

item.title: MC1479503: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps: Permission changes for select App Governance Entra roles
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps is updating App Governance permissions for select Microsoft Entra roles to align with Defender XDR Unified RBAC. Changes affect Cloud App Security, Compliance Administrator, and Compliance Data Administrator roles starting mid-October 2026. Admins should review and adjust role assignments accordingly.

item.title: MC1478970: Microsoft Purview | DLP-Create Purview network data security policies without pay-as-you-go configuration
item.description: Microsoft Purview network data security policies can now be created without pay-as-you-go configuration, using Entra Global Secure Access Internet Access with appropriate licensing. Non-Microsoft integrations still require pay-as-you-go. Rollout begins late September 2026, enabling policy creation to protect sensitive data in network traffic automatically.

item.title: MC1187682: Microsoft Edge: Microsoft 365 Copilot will support summarization and contextual grounding
item.description: Microsoft Edge for Business now supports Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat for summarizing and contextualizing multiple browser tabs, YouTube videos (available), and Microsoft 365 documents (rolling out mid-October 2026). The feature is off by default, respects DLP and policy settings, and requires Entra ID sign-in and proper licensing.

item.title: MC1461157: Microsoft Teams: Proximity join support for attendees in Teams events from Teams Rooms on Windows and Android
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows and Android will support attendee proximity join for Teams events, enabling users to quickly connect to nearby room systems. Rollout starts November 2026, completing by December. No action is needed; the feature will be enabled automatically to simplify joining meetings.

item.title: MC1478463: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Teams user reporting enabled by default
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will enable Teams user reporting by default starting late October 2026 for licensed organizations. Users can report suspicious Teams content to improve threat detection. Admins can review or opt out via a dedicated Defender portal page before October 25, 2026.

item.title: MC1442614: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced IntelliFrame with AI data channel for intelligent cameras
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will gain enhanced IntelliFrame AI features via certified intelligent cameras, enabling faster speaker framing, participant recognition, and smoother views, especially in low bandwidth. AI processing occurs on-device with metadata sent through a dedicated channel. Rollout begins mid-January 2027, enabled by default, requiring no admin action.

item.title: MC1461152: Create interactive slides in PowerPoint with Copilot skill (Windows and Mac)
item.description: PowerPoint is introducing "Create interactive slides" for Windows, Mac, and web, enabling users to make interactive visuals for complex concepts and data. Available first to Microsoft 365 Insider Beta and Frontier users, rollout completes by October 2026. No action required; admins should prepare support and training.

item.title: MC1478969: Deprecation of Citrix mVPN Support in Microsoft Edge for Android
item.description: Microsoft Edge for Android will retire Citrix Mobile VPN (mVPN) integration starting mid-September 2026 due to compatibility issues. Organizations using this integration must identify affected users, assess dependencies, plan migration to alternative solutions, and communicate changes before support ends. Other Edge features remain unaffected.

item.title: MC1478966: SharePoint: Improved site metadata size reporting
item.description: SharePoint will improve site metadata size reporting by including document library field data, providing a more complete usage view. The 1 TB metadata limit remains, but reported sizes may increase, potentially blocking new metadata additions if exceeded. Rollout starts October 20, 2026, with no content changes.

item.title: MC1478965: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Retention for Copilot Memory
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management will support retention of inactive Microsoft 365 Copilot memory versions for compliance and investigation. Historical memory items are stored in users' Exchange mailboxes, accessible via eDiscovery. Rollout begins late September 2026. No immediate action is required; organizations should review retention policies and governance.

item.title: MC1478957: Microsoft 365 profile card: View dotted-line managers in the organization panel
item.description: Microsoft 365 profile cards will show dotted-line managers in the organization panel starting October 2026, helping users understand complex reporting structures. This additive update requires organizations to provide dotted-line manager data via HR systems like SAP SuccessFactors or Workday. No action is required unless enabling this feature.

item.title: MC1478956: Microsoft Windows Autopatch: enhancements to update approval control and management capabilities
item.description: Windows Autopatch enhancements, rolling out Sept 1–Oct 15, 2026, offer improved control over Windows quality, .NET Framework, and quick machine recovery updates. Features include customizable automatic/manual approvals, deferral settings, update pausing, and detailed per-device reporting for better update management.

item.title: MC1478955: Final reminder: Microsoft Project Online retires on September 30, 2026
item.description: Microsoft Project Online will retire on September 30, 2026. Users must migrate to alternatives like Microsoft Planner, Project Server Subscription Edition, or Project Operations before then to avoid data loss. Organizations should contact a Microsoft partner immediately to plan the transition and notify users accordingly.

item.title: MC1478949: Breakout Rooms for Microsoft Teams Webinars now support up to 1,000 participants and 100 rooms
item.description: Breakout Rooms in Microsoft Teams webinars now support up to 1,000 participants and 100 rooms, enabling large-scale interactive sessions like training and workshops. No admin action is needed; organizers should be informed and guidance updated accordingly. No compliance issues identified. Available now.

item.title: MC1478946: Microsoft 365 Apps: Cloud Update - Extended rollback support for Monthly Enterprise Channel
item.description: Microsoft 365 Apps Cloud Update will allow Monthly Enterprise Channel devices to roll back to releases from two versions prior with security updates, maintaining that state until updates resume. Rolling out worldwide in September 2026, this feature enhances recovery options without automatic changes to devices.

item.title: RM572673: Microsoft 365 app: Cloud Update - Extended rollback support for Monthly Enterprise Channel
item.description: Cloud Update is expanding rollback options for devices on Monthly Enterprise Channel. Administrators will be able to roll back devices to a release from two versions prior, with the latest available security updates for that release, and keep devices in the rolled-back state across subsequent releases until they are ready to resume updates. This provides additional time to investigate and resolve compatibility issues while maintaining security coverage and centralized control through the Microso...

item.title: RM571683: Outlook: Insert Symbol

item.title: RM480734: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Endpoint DLP shows full path of target domain
item.description: Endpoint DLP should show full path of target domain and not just the domain name in Activity Explorer.

item.title: RM500396: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal: Expanding access to Diagnostics to Compliance Administrator, Security Administrator and Organization Management
item.description: We are expanding the access to Diagnostics beyond Global Admin to: Compliance Administrator, Security Administrator and Organization Management

item.title: RM491918: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal: Information Protection - Sensitivity Label support in Engage
item.description: Your organization can now manually apply Information Protection sensitivity labels in Engage. Sensitivity label support in this new application will allow admins to create labels and configure label publishing policies to determine which users and groups can manually label content in Engage. End users will be able to manually apply labels to Engage communities and in turn classify and protect their sensitive data via privacy and external user access controls.

item.title: RM501781: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Insider Risk Management: Data Security Investigations integration
item.description: Launch a pre-scoped Data Security Investigation (DSI) from an IRM case. When a data security admin identifies a risky user who needs deeper investigation, they can launch a pre-scoped investigation directly from an IRM case, allowing them to view content analysis related to that user and better assess post-incident data impact. item.title: RM516044: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Metadata understanding support for queries scoped to SharePoint document libraries or folders
item.description: We’re introducing column metadata support for queries in Microsoft 365 Copilot when a SharePoint library or folder is attached or its URL is provided. This enhancement improves contextual relevance by enabling Copilot to leverage additional metadata from the selected library, delivering more accurate and meaningful results.

item.title: RM510099: Microsoft 365 app: Add references to your Copilot Notebooks from the Quick Access section in Search on the M365 Copilot app
item.description: Users can quickly add references to a Copilot Notebook through the Quick Access section in Search on the M365 Copilot app.

item.title: RM529851: Outlook: Enriching profile cards with custom, organization-specific properties
item.description: Customers can now customize their M365 profile cards by adding custom properties unique to their organization. These properties can be sourced from external systems like HR platforms, enriching user profiles with relevant organizational details. Tenant admins can configure these properties with a display name and icon, which will appear in the Contact Information section of the profile cards.

item.title: RM560705: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Power user insights in Copilot dashboard
item.description: Understand who is building a habit using Copilot with the new power user insights in Copilot dashboard

item.title: RM561486: Microsoft Edge: Improved website compatibility with site troubleshooting controls
item.description: Microsoft Edge is introducing improvements to help users quickly resolve website issues directly from the browser. When a site is not functioning as expected, users may be guided to relevant troubleshooting options such as adjusting tracking prevention settings (e.g., Strict mode) and reviewing site-specific configurations. This experience surfaces relevant actions in-context to help users restore site functionality without navigating deep into settings.

item.title: RM567010: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - User Based Aggregation of DLP Alerts
item.description: Enable aggregation of DLP alerts based on common entities user even when multiple rules are matched. This feature should consolidate related alert events into a single alert object to: Reduce alert noise, simplify investigation workflows, enhance contextual understanding of violations.

item.title: RM567300: Microsoft Teams: Prevent presence transition to "Do not disturb" setting when screen sharing (GCC High, DoD)
item.description: We're introducing a setting that allows users to opt-out of transitioning presence automatically to Do Not Disturb when presenting or screen sharing. This ensures that they can continue to receive calls, keeping them connected and responsive without manual presence adjustments.

item.title: RM567884: Microsoft Teams: External phone call routing (GCC High, DoD)
item.description: External call routing will provide users the ability to redirect all external phone calls to either voicemail or their unanswered settings.

item.title: RM569205: Microsoft Teams: Temporarily pause all notifications
item.description: Users can now temporarily pause all notifications to minimize interruptions and stay focused on important work, meetings, or other priorities, without changing their existing notification settings.

item.title: RM501582: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Insider Risk Management - Collection policies impact on IRM
item.description: With this update, Microsoft Purview will start supporting collection policies. Collection policies allow customers to scope classification (SITs - Sensitive Information Types) and activities for scoped users. item.title: MC1473166: Brand Skill support now available in PPT Copilot [Desktop]
item.description: Brand managers can now upload custom presentation skills as Markdown files to Brand Kit for use with Copilot in PowerPoint Desktop, enabling consistent, organization-approved presentation guidance. Rollout begins mid-September 2026. Organizations should manage governance, review skills regularly, and ensure compliance with policies.

item.title: MC1473165: Brand Skill support now available in PPT Copilot [Web]
item.description: Brand managers can upload custom presentation skills as Markdown files to Brand Kit for use with Copilot in PowerPoint Web, enabling consistent, reusable guidance for presentations. Rolling out worldwide in September 2026, this requires governance, testing, and communication within organizations. Compliance and licensing must be reviewed.

item.title: MC1473163: Brand Skill support now available in PPT Copilot [Mac]
item.description: Brand Skill support in PowerPoint Copilot for Mac lets brand managers upload and share custom presentation skills as Markdown files via Brand Kit, guiding consistent presentation creation. Rolling out September 2026, it requires governance, testing, and compliance checks before publishing for organizational use.

item.title: MC1473156: Plan for Change: Intune migration for Windows Health Attestation to Microsoft Azure Attestation for Windows 11 devices
item.description: Intune will migrate Windows Health Attestation from Device Health Attestation to Microsoft Azure Attestation by early 2027. Organizations must ensure network access to Azure Attestation endpoints to maintain compliance evaluation for Windows 11 devices using health-based policies, or risk compliance failures.

item.title: MC1473155: Microsoft Purview: permissions audit log improvements
item.description: Microsoft Purview will enhance audit logging for RBAC permission checks starting late September 2026, adding two new audit operations for better access investigation and troubleshooting. This feature is enabled by default, requires no action, and improves administrators' visibility into role-based access decisions without impacting existing systems.

item.title: MC1473149: Loading Power Query data to Python in Excel Web: Retirement
item.description: Microsoft will retire support for loading Power Query data into Python in Excel for the web on October 16, 2026. This affects users combining Power Query and Python in Excel for the web but not Excel desktop. No admin action is needed; affected users should be notified and workflows reviewed.

item.title: MC1473148: Microsoft 365 Usage Reporting Updates (Microsoft Browser and Visio)
item.description: Microsoft is updating Microsoft Browser and Visio usage reports on September 21, 2026, improving metric accuracy and including more apps. Active-user counts may rise, but historical data won't change. Administrators should review reports, note the baseline change date, and validate API integrations.

item.title: MC1470415: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint: Guide Presentation Creation with Notes Steering and Strict Brand Adherence
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint introduces Strict Brand Adherence and Notes Steering settings, enabling Brand Managers to ensure presentations strictly follow approved templates and embed guidance in speaker notes. These features enhance brand consistency, reduce manual edits, and require no user action but need Brand Manager configuration.

item.title: MC1193692: Microsoft 365: Enrich profile cards with custom properties from third-party systems
item.description: Starting October 2026, Microsoft 365 admins can add up to 10 custom properties from external systems to profile cards via Microsoft Graph People connectors. This feature is off by default and configurable in the admin center, enhancing user profiles for better collaboration and discoverability.

item.title: MC1472799: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Speed up time phasing of estimates
item.description: We are announcing the ability to use the improved Time Phasing of Estimates experience in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach public preview on September 30, 2026. How does this affect me? This update enhances the Time Phasing of Estimates experience by delivering significant performance improvements across loading, recalculation, and user interactions.
