item.title: MC1472792: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Set a default booking method for the schedule board
item.description: We are announcing the ability to set a default booking method for the Schedule Board and Schedule Assistant in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach public preview on September 30, 2026. How does this affect me? When this feature is enabled, administrators can configure a default booking method in the Schedule Board settings. The selected default booking method is automatically applied to bookings created through the Schedule Board or Schedule Assistant, helping resource manag...

item.title: MC1472784: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Perform bulk reconciliation of bookings from UI
item.description: We are announcing the ability to reconcile multiple resources and date ranges in a single action in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach public preview on September 30, 2026. How does this affect me? When this feature is enabled, users can select multiple time durations and resources on the Resource Reconciliation grid. This feature allows users to: Select multiple time durations on the grid. Select multiple users on the grid. Extend the bookings for selections done on the gr...

item.title: MC1472778: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - View partial cancellation of bookings from schedule board
item.description: We are announcing the ability to view partial cancellation of resource bookings from the schedule board, without needing to delete and recreate them in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach public preview on September 30, 2026. How does this affect me? This partial booking modification feature provides resource managers with reduced manual effort, improved scheduling accuracy, preserved audit history, and unlocked partially available capacity by letting you: View continuous, m...

item.title: MC1472751: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Improve the project quote experience
item.description: We are announcing the ability to use the improved project quote experience in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach public preview on September 30, 2026. How does this affect me? The improvements to project quote provide usability enhancements designed for users to work more efficiently when creating and managing quotes. The updated interface features an optimized layout and improved use of screen space to provide a cleaner, more efficient workspace for viewing and editing bot...

item.title: MC1472598: Microsoft 365: Find more actions in the suite header menu
item.description: Microsoft 365 is moving some suite header actions, including Settings, My Day, and Sync, into the More (...) menu to reduce clutter and improve discoverability. The change, rolling out from September to November 2026, requires no admin action but may need user communication and documentation updates.

item.title: RM570438: PowerPoint: Async Notifications for PowerPoint Agent (Web)
item.description: Enable users to leave PowerPoint, switch devices, go offline, or end their workday while remaining confident that Copilot will notify them when work is complete or requires attention.

item.title: RM571194: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Cost visibility in Preview Chat and History
item.description: Now makers will have clear visibility into their consumption costs directly within preview tab and agent history for their preview/testing usage as well as all every historical run. Makers can see the costs as they test, iterate, and review conversations, making usage costs transparent throughout the development experience.

item.title: RM571195: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Cost visibility in Agent Evaluations
item.description: Now makers will have clear visibility into their consumption costs directly associated with their evaluations, including a breakdown of usage for eval generation, test runs and model grading/judgement. Makers can see the costs as they test, iterate, and review conversations, making usage transparent throughout the development lifecycle.

item.title: RM571196: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Cost visibility in Monitor tab
item.description: Now makers will have clear visibility into their consumption costs directly within Monitor tab at both a per-agent level and an estimated breakdown of those costs across the agents lifecylce. This will allow makers to see costs distributed across activities such as authoring, testing, evaluations, and production usage, helping connect overall consumption to specific actions and experiences.

item.title: RM571304: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize, discover and manage features from one place
item.description: A single place in Project Operations where administrators and end users can discover the core features relevant to them in lite or resource/non-stocked deployments.

item.title: RM560396: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Expand protection to Copilot + PC devices for Recall snapshots through custom policies
item.description: Microsoft Purview Endpoint data loss prevention is expanding coverage to Copilot + PCs initially to support Recall snapshots and determining whether policies exist to prevent capture of windows containing restricted sensitivity labels and Sensitive information types (SITs). Purview admins will author Endpoint DLP custom policies to integrate with Windows Copilot + PC Recall setup by Intune admins for Copilot + PC devices exclusively.

item.title: RM570437: PowerPoint: Async Notifications for PowerPoint Agent (Windows Desktop)
item.description: Enable users to leave PowerPoint, switch devices, go offline, or end their workday while remaining confident that Copilot will notify them when work is complete or requires attention.

item.title: RM537269: Microsoft Teams: Express voice enrollment in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Express voice enrollment makes registering your voice in Teams fast and easy. Your profile enables features like voice isolation, speaker recognition, identification in a meeting room and transcripts, and enhanced meeting recaps and insights from Microsoft 365 Copilot. If you don’t yet have a voice profile, just go to the recognition tab in Teams settings and opt-in to enroll your voice simply by speaking during a meeting. Admins can enable or disable this feature.

item.title: RM571310: Outlook: Spell check before sending emails in new Outlook
item.description: If you don’t want to check spelling manually for every message—or you’re worried you might forget!—you can set Outlook to check spelling for you every time before sending emails.

item.title: RM568787: Microsoft Edge: v.153 - Changes to local IP address detection for proxy auto-config (PAC) scripts
item.description: Microsoft Edge is changing how it selects the local network address reported to proxy auto-config (PAC) scripts and is adding administrator control over it. The default IPv4 and IPv6 probe destinations now match Chromium’s defaults. Administrators can override these defaults using the PacMyIpAddressIPv4ProbeAddress and PacMyIpAddressIPv6ProbeAddress policies when required by their network routing.

item.title: RM567470: OneDrive: Exclude specific folders from syncing
item.description: OneDrive for Windows and Mac will let users exclude specific folders from syncing, so folders that do not belong in the cloud, such as developer tooling folders like PowerShell modules, Visual Studio configuration, and node modules, stay local on the device instead of uploading to OneDrive. Administrators can define folder exclusion rules for their organization.

item.title: RM567301: Microsoft Teams: New controls for quick views in the chat list
item.description: The new chats and channels experience introduced quick views at the top of the chat and channels list. These are views into mentions, followed threads and more. This update allows users to choose when and how these quick views are shown. Users will have options such as always show, always hide and show only when unread. Users will also be able to collapse the quick views section.

item.title: RM566703: Microsoft Edge: Upgraded Copilot new tab page
item.description: Search, chat, and explore the web from one search box with Copilot-suggested actions and curated work content to help your users get things done faster on the Copilot new tab page. Users will see upgraded Copilot new tab page functionality and features.
